issues.source_reading: Plural they and good-versus-strong alternatives in initial stay sentence are not formalized.
issues.downstream_implication: A unique executable predicate could overstate source precision.
issues.disposition: Keep source sequence and ambiguity. Root may resolve only by reasoned source interpretation, explicitly labelled.

issues.source_reading: Good, evil, strong, weak, lately, with and most friendly have no quantitative thresholds or conflict precedence in span.
issues.downstream_implication: No weights, recency window, association orb or tie-break can be claimed source-defined here.
issues.disposition: Preserve qualitative candidates; earlier general definitions may be linked without silent invention.

issues.source_reading: Starred margin adds that house stood inconveniently for trade.
issues.downstream_implication: Omission would turn practical alternative into wholly supernatural reading.
issues.disposition: Included as explicit alternative; do not remove in integration.

issues.source_reading: Lilly supplies aggregate memory of no regret/thanks and personal opinion about cursed houses.
issues.downstream_implication: These cannot become prospective case confirmations, measured accuracy or established causation.
issues.disposition: Keep testimonial/theological evidence classes and author qualifications.

issues.source_reading: Stay/remove rules introduced as some say; terminal treasure block attributed to Alkindus.
issues.downstream_implication: Attribution would be lost if every rule were represented as Lilly independent finding.
issues.disposition: Attribution fields preserved; terminal digging sentence identified as inside attributed passage without separate reattribution.

issues.source_reading: No-Mars-aspect subject and reach of OR Moon in rain signs are not fully explicit.
issues.downstream_implication: Forced formalization may add or drop required conditions.
issues.disposition: Retain alternative parses rather than claim one canonical Boolean condition.

issues.source_reading: Rain glyph list reads Cancer, Leo, Aquarius, Pisces.
issues.downstream_implication: Replacing Leo with Scorpio or a watery-triplicity list would silently alter source.
issues.disposition: Original list preserved; no correction or external harmonization.

issues.source_reading: Receiving fortune ascending in his latitude is explicit but not defined here.
issues.downstream_implication: Do not equate it uncritically with north latitude, positive latitude derivative or another convention.
issues.disposition: Retain literal phrase; no ungrounded numerical implementation.

issues.source_reading: General presence list includes North Node, followed by plural own houses qualification.
issues.downstream_implication: Node domicile rules cannot be invented to satisfy wording.
issues.disposition: Preserve inclusion and mark own-house applicability unresolved.

issues.source_reading: First combine treasure significator and lord 7 if distinct; next sentence directs absolute lord 7 when significator be not lord 7 or have affinity with him.
issues.downstream_implication: Mixture versus fallback and not/or scope do not yield a unique algorithm.
issues.disposition: Both directions retained with crosslinks; no harmonizing hidden assumption.

issues.source_reading: No planet unfortunate when own-house or essentially dignified and significator.
issues.downstream_implication: A fixed malefic=infortune implementation would contradict stated reservation.
issues.disposition: Keep dignity-role qualification separate; no dignity system invented.

issues.source_reading: Mine and iron-stone clauses inherit context but do not fully restate dignity prerequisites; iron-stone follows both strong and weak Mars sentences.
issues.downstream_implication: Cannot silently promote every material statement to same dignity condition.
issues.disposition: Attach context and explicit uncertainty; Venus/Mercury also retain only stated prerequisites.

issues.source_reading: Question specifies ownership, hider relation and sometimes exact mineral/object being sought.
issues.downstream_implication: Such inputs cannot later be counted as chart-predicted discoveries.
issues.disposition: Mark prior-known inputs and do not manufacture historical case success.

issues.source_reading: Cadent followed by and both the Lights especially Moon leaves elided cadency and subject of have no aspect uncertain; next ascendant-lord condition is OR.
issues.downstream_implication: Flattening could add conjuncts or erase alternative negative branch.
issues.disposition: Keep candidate alternatives, explicit OR and no automatic override of positive testimony.

issues.source_reading: Good aspect betwixt lord 1 and Moon and that fortune, viz. good aspect and reception, does not specify pairwise edge set or reception direction.
issues.downstream_implication: Graph cannot be made exact from this span without interpretive assumptions.
issues.disposition: Preserve all actors plus good-aspect AND reception requirements; flag wiring.

issues.source_reading: Newly entered sign means shallow; farther in sign means deeper.
issues.downstream_implication: Degrees-to-length, fixed thirds, units or maximum depth would be invented.
issues.disposition: Keep ordinal function only.

issues.source_reading: Source has collation of light and nature; acquisition treasure applies to lord 1 differs from digging significators -> lord 2 or Moon separates treasure then applies lord 1.
issues.downstream_implication: Modern terminology substitution or merged directions can change doctrine.
issues.disposition: Literal term and directional/temporal chains retained.

issues.source_reading: Source sends unremoved-goods location to first chapter of this house.
issues.downstream_implication: This reader cannot assign content from prohibited earlier pages.
issues.disposition: Root to link to corresponding independently admitted source span.

issues.source_reading: No dated named enquiry or diagram occurs in inspected span.
issues.downstream_implication: Historical chart reproduction or prior/forecast/confirmation chronology would be fabricated.
issues.disposition: Case ledger explicitly empty; aggregate feedback is separate.

issues.source_reading: House system, zodiac, ephemeris, orbs, dignity tables, Fortune formula and several implementation conventions not given in span.
issues.downstream_implication: Source rules do not by themselves define reproducible chart calculations.
issues.disposition: No chart calculated; local unknowns explicit under CALCULATION_LIMITS.

issues.source_reading: Modality-to-location sentence does not re-name the sign subject; next depth sentence identifies planet significator.
issues.downstream_implication: Nearest-context treasure-significator reading is inference, not exact explicit assignment.
issues.disposition: Implicit attachment labelled; no arbitrary multi-significator resolution.

issues.source_reading: Different favourable/unfavourable testimonies coexist without source ranking.
issues.downstream_implication: No universal dominance rule, score or cancellation order can be attributed to this span.
issues.disposition: Preserve competing claims, modalities and crosslinks.

disposition_note: These are source-interpretation limits and resolved glyph/margin readings. They do not imply the historical text is incorrect, and are not new owner permission gates.
